page.content:
Apidanos is the god of the River of Thessalia (in modern-day Greece). Apidanos's river is one of several small rivers such as the Enipeus and Titaressos that flow into the Peneios' river of the same name.

page.overview:
Who is Apidanos?

Apidanos is the god of the River of Thessalia (in modern-day Greece). Apidanos's river is one of several small rivers such as the Enipeus and Titaressos that flow into the Peneios' river of the same name.
